participation.context: Proposed playing twice, and kept the meat.
participation.name: Thomas Pope

participation.context: Kept the dinner on her own slate, and sent the phrase out with the men.
participation.name: Agnes Tipping

participation.context: Asked after the sums, feared the farthing more than the day, and closed the plot.
participation.name: John Heminges

participation.context: Said who knows what matters, and left the king's leaf at home.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Asked a wage for the invented day, and offered sixpence for a thirty-second of May.
participation.name: Will Kemp

participation.context: Paid the twelve pence, reported the page, named Long Meg, and brought no receipt.
participation.name: William Blackwage, Ralph Raye, Richard Hoope

participation.context: Took the twelve pence and had yesterday's play set against the thirtieth.
participation.name: Philip Henslowe

story.body: You heard twelve pence, a page dated out of the month, and a farthing that was right. You gave the company the sentence. Kemp did not get his extra wage. No sum of the other house was spoken.
